comments.author: Kim_Bruning
comments.why: Example of wild behavior from simple deterministic automata
comments.text: There's an entire field of deterministic mathematics called Chaos Theory, that pretty much encompasses what it says on the tin. It turns out that -innocent, simple looking- finite state deterministic automata can actually be less predictable than the non-deterministic kind. (and it can get pretty wild! [VIDEO] )
